title: Burney Wealth
description: Burney Wealth Management provides a comprehensive suite of financial services including financial planning, investment management, tax planning, and retirement planning, aimed at helping clients grow and preserve their wealth. The firm emphasizes a cohesive approach through a dedicated team of fiduciaries, certified financial planners, and credentialed investment professionals. Their target clientele includes business owners and individuals planning for retirement, who seek tailored and tax-efficient wealth management solutions. Established in 1974, Burney Wealth Management is recognized nationally for its dedication to service and professional excellence.
